reason: I already reorder Toplux when it runs out and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. $29.99 is more than I pay now, so I would not switch for a brand I have never heard of.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer, and I do not need another supplement in the drawer.
would_change_my_mind: A first box at around $15 to $18 that I could try without feeling I wasted money, plus a real review from someone like me saying it helped them sleep.
